hero.title: The CBO Method
hero.subtitle: Over 10 years of top-level training and clinical experience condensed into a system that puts people at the centre.

intro.title: There is no perfect programme. There is the perfect programme for you.
intro.body: At CBO we don't work with standard protocols or magazine diets. We start with a deep analysis of who you are, where you're starting from and where you want to go. From there, we build your programme from scratch.

pillars.title: The CBO Method
pillars.p1Body: We analyse your clinical history, mobility, strength and goals to design a personalised plan.
pillars.p2Body: We organise your sessions in the CBO SALUD app, adapted to your level and needs, with ongoing monitoring.
pillars.p3Body: Training, pilates, dietitian consultation and physiotherapy work together to provide you with comprehensive care.
pillars.p4Body: Small groups Monday to Friday, 7:00 to 22:00, with 1-hour sessions and easy access to changes and make-up sessions.

process.title: From first contact to results
process.step1Body: You tell us your goal and we do an initial assessment to understand your starting point.
process.step2Body: We design your tailored training, dietitian consultation or physiotherapy plan — or the combination you need.
process.step3Body: We start working together with periodic reviews to make sure you're progressing and to adjust the plan when needed.
process.step4Body: Our goal is not a one-off result, but to educate and accompany you so you maintain results long-term.

app.title: Your progress, always at hand
app.body: Through the CBO App you'll have access to your personalised plan, track your progress, check your training sessions, review your diet plan and communicate with your specialist. All in one place, from any device.

hero.title: Team CBO
hero.subtitle: A team of highly qualified specialists, working in a coordinated way to give you the comprehensive care you deserve.

intro.title: We built CBO so it can grow with you
intro.body: CBO started as Carlos Bernardo's personal project, but always with a clear vision: to build a team of specialists capable of offering comprehensive, highest-quality care. Today we are a team of trainers, physiotherapists, dietitians and pilates instructors who share the same philosophy and the same method.

values.title: Our values
values.v1Body: We demand of ourselves to always be up to date with the latest scientific evidence in our fields.
values.v2Body: The team's specialists work in a coordinated way so that your care is truly comprehensive.
values.v3Body: Your progress matters to us. We are available, honest and committed to you from day one.
values.v4Body: We don't promise what we can't deliver. We work for results that last.

cta.title: Want to join our team?
cta.body: If you're a health and sport professional with top-level training who shares our philosophy, we'd love to meet you.
